name.en: Fake police officer calling from a local number

how.en: Someone calls from what looks like a local mobile number and says they are a police officer. They ask you a few questions, then want personal details, such as your email address, to set up an “appointment” that doesn’t exist. The number is spoofed, so it looks Maltese.

text.en: A local-looking number calls and the caller says they are from the police.
They ask questions as if there were a case about you.
They ask for personal details, including your email, to book an appointment.

Caller: Good afternoon, I’m an officer from the district police station. We need to speak to you about a matter that involves you. Before I give you a time to come in, can you confirm your full name, ID card number and your email so I can send you the details?

en: caller said he was from the police
police call from a mobile number
asked for my ID card number
The “police” calling from a mobile number and asking for personal details.
Being told you are part of a case without any letter or visit.
Hang up and don’t give any details.
To check whether the call was real, call Crime Stop on 119 yourself.
Report the number to the Police.

sources.title: Police warn of 'spoofed' calls as scammers impersonate officers
